nonblocking_limitations: Figure-only exact bars/curves were not digitized; no unsupported exact values were fabricated.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair recovered the locally supported activity rows and reconciled database conflicts. The paper is publication-grade with explicit cautions for DRAMP broad activity/terminal-modification conflicts and figure-only values not digitized.

caution_findings.note: DRAMP broad Antimicrobial, Anticancer label is only partly supported locally: the paper supports AP1-Z5b anticancer activity and sequence identity, but not an AP1-Z5b antimicrobial assay target/value in recoverable local material.
DRAMP lists free termini, while primary methods/simulation context includes terminal amidation/capping language; the conflict is preserved rather than normalized.
Figure-only curve/bar values for mutants other than text-stated IC50 values were not digitized; supported qualitative/statistical findings are retained without fabricated exact numbers.
Supplementary Document S1 was opened for sequence and simulation metadata; it contains no additional parser-supported activity/toxicity value table beyond primary text/figures.
